newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI in A$22 mln plant upgrade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI in A$22 mln plant upgrade.

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it would commence a A$22 million upgrade of its surfactants plant located at Botany, in New South Wales.
ICI said the investment would increase plant productivity through improvement of existing facilities and the establishment of a centralised packaging facility.
"This upgrade will take us closer to our goal of becoming world competitive by enhancing the plant's overall efficiency, reliability and product quality," said ICI Division manager Ian Gilmour.
